svg.title: Incident Management
svg.desc: Incident Management. A practised response when production breaks: declare early, assign roles, mitigate first and keep everyone informed. Step 1, Without a process: No process: 9 people debug in a shared channel, 2 restart pods at once, and no one tells support. Step 2, Declared and organised: Paged at 20:14, Mai declares SEV-2 at 20:17 and takes command: one channel, one doc, clear roles. Step 3, Mitigate first: Mitigate first: rollback to 1.42.0 at 20:24, payments.fallback on at 20:31, errors 0.3% by 20:36. Step 4, Resolve and hand over: Closed 21:30 with a handoff note; a postmortem follows. Avoid heroes, debugging ICs, MTTR targets.
